title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of ultra-fine grained MoNbTaTiV refractory high-entropy alloy fabricated by spark plasma sintering
process_description: prepared by mechanical alloying with ball-to-powder ratio 10:1 at 350 rpm for 40h under argon, followed by spark plasma sintering at 1600°C for 10min under 50MPa pressure in vacuum (<1.3×10⁻² Pa) with heating to 700°C in 3min then 100°C/min ramp rate
